title: More visitors, fewer purchases?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the two denominators in a choice funnel.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the two denominators in a choice funnel affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Purchases, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the two denominators in a choice funnel in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Of 1000 toy visitors, fraction 0.6 stop and fraction 0.03 of those buy. How many purchases are expected?

claims.text: More attention at the top of a funnel need not mean more final choices. Conditional conversion and reach jointly determine the result. This comparison isolates the two denominators in a choice funnel.
